title: Problem with all RTP resources in Rpg maker MV

posts.author: LynX
posts.body:
Hello I've got problem with all RTP resources. The files are in my game project = new created one a while ago but when I go to create event and select event graphic I've got that:
and also I've got no BGM files or sound files.
The rpg maker I use is on steam platform. I reinstalled the software and nothing changed. I'm using Windows 10.
Any suggestion how I'm suppose to repair that problem ?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Reinstalling the software does nothing to your existing project. Did you make a new project after reinstalling rpg maker? Have you tried verifying file integrity with steam? If so, maybe show us a screenshot of your tileset folder.

posts.author: LynX
posts.body:
I've figure it out when I choose my project folder like F:\#Rpg maker\Rpg maker MV\Project 3
there is problem with rtp when I put my project into C"\My Documents everything working fine.
I don't know why. Doesn't matter my project are now on hard drive C. Problem solved.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Be careful with your file and folder names.
MV is an HTML-based program, so including characters that aren't valid in URLs can cause files to not load - that includes spaces and symbols.
That wouldn't be the cause of this problem, but I see both spaces and the pound symbol in your example, so I thought I'd warn you.
